name: backlog-factory
description: An agentic app that triages your GitHub backlog: sorts each issue (good problem? five whys, first principles), reproduces bugs in your clone, then a fixer and a reviewer loop until the fix is green. You merge. It never writes to GitHub.
author: ATO 2026 workshop

crons.name: factory-weekday
crons.message: Run one Backlog Factory pass: follow the factory-triage, factory-reproduce and factory-fix-review skills on the repo folder saved on the Backlog Factory page. Scheduled run: sort and reproduce only, start no fixes, write nothing to GitHub.
